## Summary

Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Fix the invitation validator before merge. It still accepts passwords below the new 12-character minimum.

## Changes

The pull request raises the signup and reset password minimum from 8 to 12 characters and updates both boundary tests to cover lengths 11, 12, and 13.

## Critical

- app/signup.py:1 — correctness — Enforce the 12-character minimum for invitations — An eight-character password fails the updated signup check but still passes the invitation check, which uses the minimum of 8 at `app/invite.py:1`. — Invited users can set passwords that violate the stated security policy. — Fix: Update the minimum at `app/invite.py:1` and extend `test_password_boundaries` in `tests/test_invite.py:7`.
